fact: The document states the last national census in Nigeria was held in November 2006.

The document states the National Population Commission has produced digital maps, procured tablets, demarcated the whole country and trained staff for the first biometric census, with a N980 billion budget proposed to the President and biometric devices still to be procured; no census date is set (dated by publication, 2025-03-08).

The minister said Milsat supported the National Population Commission's mapping of more than 65 million properties in preparation for Nigeria's first digital census; no date given, dated by publication (2026-10-07).

The National Bureau of Statistics released anonymised v1.0 microdata of the Nigeria Labour Force Survey Q1 2024 (8,836 households in 36 states and the FCT, collected 2024-01-31 to 2024-03-20), version dated 2024-04-15.
